items.title: Hal Espinosa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 20, 2024
items.q: I have a little story here from Derek Smith, the late pianist who came over from England to New York.

ctx.x: I have a little story here from Derek Smith, the late pianist who came over from England to New York. And of course he went to the musicians’ union ‘cause he wanted to start working and they said, “Six months, come back in six months.” So he did. And when he got there the person said okay there’s an audition and this is a quote from him: “So I go into this room, there’s the piano. And the guy said, ‘What’s that instrument over there?’ So I said, ‘What are you talking about? It’s a piano.’ He says, ‘You’re in now…

That was a good audition. You know I only auditioned twice in my life. One was to get the scholarship at Arizona State and the other is when I got drafted after I graduated from Arizona State I was drafted in the Army. And after the six month — I mean six weeks of Basic Training then they’d send you to Advanced Training — I think that’s what they called it. And I asked if I could audition for the band. So they sent me to the band, and there’s this little cornet player. He had — well I was 25 then I think — 24 or…
